label: Google Workspace
description: Gmail and Google Drive in one tab, with one Google sign-in. Read, search, draft and organize mail across several Google accounts, and pull 3D models, textures and audio from Drive straight into UEFN (allowlisted types, size caps, nothing executed). Ducky can do everything the tab can; sending, trash and sharing always ask first, and mail stays on this PC.

settings.sections.title: Google accounts
settings.sections.description: Ask your ducky to "connect Google" or press Sign in with Google in the Google Workspace tab: a Google sign-in opens in your browser, you pick an account and approve, and that's it. Nothing to paste; your password never touches the app. Connect as many accounts as you like; the tab lists them, with 'All inboxes' plus a filter for each. Tokens are stored encrypted on this PC. Say "disconnect <account>" (or use the tab) to sign one out.

settings.sections.title: What Ducky may use
settings.sections.description: Sign-in starts with read-only Drive access. Each switch below adds its access only when you turn it on: Google asks you to approve it on the next sign-in. Mail and files go straight from this PC to Google and stay on this PC.

properties.label: Gmail
properties.description: Read, search, draft and organize your mail. Sending, trash and label deletes always ask you first.

properties.label: Manage Drive
properties.description: Upload, create folders, move, rename, share and trash Drive files. Off = read-only Drive.

settings.sections.title: Gmail
settings.sections.description: How often new mail is checked, how far back the local copy goes, and whether pictures inside emails load on their own.

properties.label: Check for new mail
properties.description: New mail also starts workflows that use the 'New email received' trigger.

properties.label: Keep a local copy of the last
properties.description: Subject, sender and snippet of recent mail, kept on this PC so the inbox opens fast and Ducky can find mail by meaning. Older mail is still searched on Google.

properties.label: Load pictures in emails automatically
properties.description: Off = pictures from the web stay blocked until you press Load images, so senders can't see when you opened their mail.

settings.sections.title: Your Drive folder
settings.sections.description: Optional but handy: paste the link (or id) of one Drive folder where you keep assets. Then "list my Drive" / "search my Drive" default to that folder, so you just drop models into it and ask Ducky to pull them. Leave blank to browse your whole Drive.

properties.label: Drive folder link or id
properties.description: Right-click the folder in Google Drive → Share → Copy link, and paste it here. Everything you drop in that folder becomes pullable into UEFN.

settings.sections.title: Downloads
settings.sections.description: Files land in the app's staging folder (AppData → downloads/googledrive) and are imported into UEFN from there. Only model/texture/audio/zip files are ever downloaded; zips are extracted with the same allowlist; nothing is executed.

properties.label: Max download size
properties.description: Hard cap per file (and 2× this for a zip's extracted contents). Gmail attachments use the same cap.

settings.sections.title: Advanced (optional)
settings.sections.description: You do not need any of this for normal use. Use your own Google Cloud project only if you'd rather not use the built-in sign-in: paste a Desktop-app OAuth Client ID + secret and sign-in goes straight to Google with your client. An API key lets you browse public 'anyone with link' Drive folders without signing in at all.

properties.label: OAuth Client ID (override)
properties.description: From your own Google Cloud project (Desktop app client, Gmail API and Drive API enabled). Overrides the built-in sign-in.

properties.label: OAuth Client secret (override)
properties.description: Shown next to the Client ID when you create it. Stored encrypted on this PC.

properties.label: Google API key
properties.description: Optional. Only needed to browse public Drive folders without signing in.

steps.title: Google Workspace setup
steps.body: Choose what Ducky may use (Gmail, Manage Drive) and an optional Drive folder of assets. Press Google to open its settings.

steps.title: You're set
steps.body: Press Sign in with Google in the Google Workspace tab (or ask Ducky to connect Google). Ducky can then read and draft mail and pull models, textures and audio from Drive into UEFN. Sending and trash always ask you first.
